unreachable: Could not reach the API. Check that the backend is running.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

ai.failed: The AI could not complete this request. Try again.
ai.rate_limited: The AI provider is handling too many requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
ai.context_too_long: That is more text than the AI can take at once. Select a shorter passage.
ai.content_filtered: The AI provider declined to respond to this content.
ai.upstream_unavailable: The AI provider is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.
ai.invalid_key: AI is not set up on this server: its API key is missing or was rejected. Ask whoever runs it to check GEMINI_API_KEY.
ai.selection_invalid: Select the text you want rewritten first.
ai.daily_limit: This workspace has used up today's AI budget. It resets at midnight UTC.
ai.concurrency_limit: This workspace already has as many AI responses in progress as it is allowed. Wait for one to finish.
ai.timeout: The response took too long and was stopped.
ai.interrupted: The server restarted while writing this response. Try again.
ai.query_not_found: That AI response no longer exists.
ai.query_not_completed: Only a finished response can be inserted.
ai.stream_lost: Lost the connection to the response. Check your network and try again.

auth.email_undeliverable: That email domain does not exist or cannot receive mail. Check the address for typos.
auth.email_unverified: Confirm your email address before signing in.
auth.invalid_credentials: That email address and password do not match.
auth.invalid_token: Your session is not valid. Please sign in again.
auth.refresh_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.refresh_revoked: This session was ended for security. Sign in again.
auth.refresh_unknown: Your session is not valid. Please sign in again.
auth.reset_code_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again, or request a new one.
auth.reset_locked: Too many wrong codes. Password recovery for this address is paused for a few minutes.
auth.reset_token_invalid: This password reset has expired or was already used. Start over to get a new code.
auth.session_revoked: This session has ended because the account's password was changed. Sign in again.
auth.token_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.verification_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again, or request a new one.
auth.wrong_token_type: Your session is not valid. Please sign in again.

document.not_found: That document does not exist, or you cannot open it.
document.stale: This document changed while you were working on it.
document.schema_mismatch: This page runs a different version of the editor from the server. Reload the page to keep editing.

import.unsupported_type: Only Word documents (.docx) can be imported.
import.legacy_doc: This is an older Word document (.doc), which cannot be imported. Open it in Word and save it as .docx, then import that.
import.encrypted: This document is protected by a password. Remove the password in Word, save it, and import it again.
import.corrupt: This document could not be read: it may be damaged. Open it in Word and save a fresh copy, then try again.
import.too_large: That file is larger than the import limit.

realtime.invalid_ticket: Could not join the document's live session. Reload the page.
realtime.idle: The live connection went quiet and was closed.
realtime.unsupported_frame: The live connection received something it could not read.
realtime.too_many_edits: Edits are arriving faster than the server accepts. Slow down a little.

embedding.failed: The embedding service could not process this. Try again.
embedding.quota_exhausted: The embedding service's request quota is used up for now; a daily quota resets the next day.
embedding.daily_limit: This workspace has used up today's embedding requests; the count resets at midnight UTC.
embedding.input_too_long: A passage was longer than the embedding model accepts, so it was not sent rather than be cut short. Please report this.
embedding.invalid_key: Embeddings are not set up on this server: the API key is missing or was rejected. Ask whoever runs it to check GEMINI_API_KEY, or to use EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local.
embedding.unavailable: The embedding service is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.

member.absent: They are not a member of this workspace.
member.duplicate: They are already a member of this workspace.
member.is_owner: The owner cannot be removed from their own workspace.
member.unknown_email: No account uses that email address.
member.unverified: That person has not confirmed their email address yet.

rate_limit.exceeded: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

request.invalid: Some of what you entered was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
request.too_large: That is too large to send.

retrieval.mixed_models: This workspace's sources were embedded by more than one model, and their passages cannot be compared. They need to be re-embedded with one model.
retrieval.model_mismatch: This workspace's sources were embedded by a different model from the one the server uses now. They need to be re-embedded before they can be searched.

server.error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.

source.not_found: That source does not exist, or it was deleted.
source.unsupported_type: Only PDF, Word (.docx), plain text and Markdown files can be uploaded.
source.archive: Archives and compressed files are not accepted. Upload the documents inside them one by one.
source.empty: This file has no text to read.
source.too_large: That file is larger than the upload limit.
source.storage_quota: This workspace has no room for that file. Delete a source to free some space.
source.not_failed: Only a source that failed can be retried.
source.parse_failed: This file could not be read: it may be damaged, or written in a way the reader does not understand. Trying again will not help; upload another copy.
source.no_text: This PDF has no text layer, as a scan does. Text recognition (OCR) is not supported; upload a PDF whose text can be selected.
source.encrypted: This file is protected by a password. Remove the password and upload it again.
source.chunk_not_found: That passage is no longer available: its source was deleted or processed again.
source.not_viewable: This kind of file cannot be shown here. Download it to open it.
source.text_unavailable: This source has not been read yet, or could not be read, so there is no text to show.

workspace.not_found: That workspace does not exist, or you are not a member of it.
workspace.role_too_low: Your role in this workspace does not allow that.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
validation.passwordTooLong: That password is too long. Use at most 72 bytes.
validation.codeIncomplete: Enter all six digits of the code.
